lists.name: What I do
items: Full stack development mainly in TypeScript with popular frameworks like Nest.js for backend and NextJS for frontend.
Small programs in Python, sometimes using libs such as matplotlib for example
Small programs in Java, sometimes just to experiment

lists.name: Experiences
items: Contributed to a SaaS platform development, building backend features with TypeScript (tRPC) and managing database architecture using Supabase and Prisma (including migrations, RLS, and deployment).
Enhanced UI and development workflow, integrating TailwindCSS for styling and using GitHub for version control and collaboration.
Developed full-stack web features with PHP (Symfony), including server logic, database management (with PostgreSQL), and Stripe payment integration.
Built and styled frontend views using Twig and Bootstrap, and managed version control with GitLab.
